tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation rejected the four-parameter memory-kernel fit. The rows show smooth, short-horizon transient behavior, but no gradient variation and no long-horizon evidence. Fit a compact relaxational response using current state, current and past input, and horizon, rather than claiming the archived ODE or buying a redundant probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The earlier fine batch did not resolve the archived ODE, and the available open-branch probe returned only a duplicate zero-gradient observation.
There is no evidence of high-frequency chaotic oscillations and only one stationary model family has been refuted; a different fitted smooth transient law is still testable.
All horizons are short and tightly clustered, so a slow-horizon reversal cannot be identified from these observations.
